title: Morgan says Brown was CIA research

tellings.quote: Morgan has told Paul that Townsend was basically CIA research.

plain: The inventor Townsend Brown, who claimed electric fields could make objects move without propellers or jets, was "basically CIA research", according to a man known only as Morgan. Jan Lundquist passes this on in Michels's documentary about Brown, saying Morgan told it to a writer named Paul Schatzkin, so it comes to us third-hand, and if true it would mean the CIA quietly backed Brown's work sometime between the 1950s and 1970s.
